blocks.zh: 品質管理系統要求與管理責任 — Clauses 4 & 5
blocks.en: Quality Management System Requirements and Management Responsibility — Clauses 4 & 5

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 QMS 文件層次架構：質量方針 → 質量手冊 → 程序文件 → 作業指導書 → 記錄；理解 Medical Device File（4.2.3）作為獨立要求的特殊地位
blocks.en: Master the QMS documentation hierarchy: quality policy → quality manual → procedures → work instructions → records; understand the special status of the Medical Device File (4.2.3) as a stand-alone requirement

blocks.zh: 熟悉文件管制（4.2.4）的 8 項控制要求，能識別哪些控制對 CDMO 的跨市場操作最具挑戰性
blocks.en: Become familiar with the 8 control requirements for control of documents (4.2.4), and identify which controls are most challenging for a CDMO operating across multiple markets

blocks.zh: 理解 4.1 外包流程控制的邏輯：責任不能外包，只有執行可以外包；外包必須有書面品質協議
blocks.en: Understand the logic of outsourced process control in 4.1: responsibility cannot be outsourced, only the performance of the work can; outsourcing must be covered by a written quality agreement

blocks.zh: 區分 ISO 13485 和 ISO 9001 在「品質方針」（5.3）上的關鍵差異：13485 無「持續改進」義務
blocks.en: Distinguish the key difference between ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 on the quality policy (5.3): 13485 has no obligation of "continual improvement"

blocks.zh: 掌握管理審查（5.6）的醫療器械特定輸入項目，特別是法規要求和上市後監控資訊的必要性
blocks.en: Master the medical device-specific inputs to management review (5.6), especially the need for regulatory requirements and post-market surveillance information

blocks.zh: Clause 4.1 — 品質管理系統一般要求
blocks.en: Clause 4.1 — General Requirements for the Quality Management System

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 概念解析：4.1 的三層邏輯
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The Three-Layer Logic of 4.1

blocks.zh: Clause 4.1 的結構是：
blocks.en: The structure of Clause 4.1 is:

blocks.zh: 4.1.1：建立 QMS 的基本義務 + 識別組織角色
blocks.en: 4.1.1: the basic obligation to establish a QMS + identifying the organization's role

blocks.zh: 4.1.2–4.1.3：流程識別與控制方法（PDCA 循環的架構）
blocks.en: 4.1.2–4.1.3: process identification and control methods (the PDCA cycle framework)

blocks.zh: 4.1.4：變更控制（任何對 QMS 流程的修改都需評估影響）
blocks.en: 4.1.4: change control (any change to QMS processes must be evaluated for its impact)

blocks.zh: 4.1.5：外包流程控制（責任不可外包）
blocks.en: 4.1.5: control of outsourced processes (responsibility cannot be outsourced)

blocks.zh: 4.1.6：QMS 軟體驗證（2016 版新增的重要要求）
blocks.en: 4.1.6: validation of QMS software (an important requirement added in the 2016 edition)

blocks.zh: 對多國市場 CDMO 而言，4.1.1 要求「文件化在適用法規下的角色」意味著：在不同客戶/市場的 QMS 範疇聲明中，需要明確列出適用的法規清單（FDA 21 CFR Part 820、EU MDR、PMDA 等）。
blocks.en: For a CDMO serving multiple national markets, the 4.1.1 requirement to "document the role(s) undertaken by the organization under the applicable regulatory requirements" means that the QMS scope statement for each customer/market must clearly list the applicable regulations (FDA 21 CFR Part 820, EU MDR, PMDA, etc.).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：4.1.5 外包控制 — 最容易被忽視的要求
blocks.en: Key Point: 4.1.5 Outsourcing Control — The Most Easily Overlooked Requirement

blocks.zh: 4.1.5 的核心邏輯：外包執行，但不能外包責任。
blocks.en: The core logic of 4.1.5: you can outsource the performance, but you cannot outsource the responsibility.

blocks.zh: 稽核員針對外包控制最常問的問題：
blocks.en: The questions auditors ask most often about outsourcing control:

blocks.zh: 是否有書面品質協議（Written Quality Agreement）？
blocks.en: Is there a Written Quality Agreement?

blocks.zh: 品質協議中是否規定了績效指標和稽核權利？
blocks.en: Does the quality agreement specify performance indicators and audit rights?

blocks.zh: 控制措施是否與風險成比例（高風險外包 = 更嚴格控制）？
blocks.en: Are the controls proportionate to the risk (higher-risk outsourcing = stricter controls)?

blocks.zh: 外包商是否依照 7.4（採購）進行資格確認？
blocks.en: Has the outsourced provider been qualified in accordance with 7.4 (purchasing)?

blocks.zh: 常見失誤：CDMO 將滅菌外包後僅依賴滅菌廠的 CoC（Certificate of Compliance），未對滅菌驗證資料進行獨立審查 → 此為 4.1.5 的 Major NC。
blocks.en: Common failure: after outsourcing sterilization, the CDMO relies only on the sterilizer's CoC (Certificate of Compliance) and does not independently review the sterilization validation data → this is a Major NC against 4.1.5.

blocks.zh: 概念解析：4.1.6 QMS 軟體驗證 — 2016 版新增要求
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: 4.1.6 Validation of QMS Software — A New Requirement in the 2016 Edition

blocks.zh: 這是 2016 版相對於 2003 版最重要的新增要求之一。涵蓋範圍：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important additions in the 2016 edition compared with the 2003 edition. The scope covers:

blocks.zh: 電子批次記錄系統（eBMR/EBR）
blocks.en: Electronic batch record systems (eBMR/EBR)

blocks.zh: LIMS（實驗室資訊管理系統）
blocks.en: LIMS (laboratory information management systems)

blocks.zh: ERP 中的品質模組（SAP QM 等）
blocks.en: Quality modules in ERP (SAP QM, etc.)

blocks.zh: 統計分析軟體（Minitab、JMP 等）用於 QC 放行決策
blocks.en: Statistical analysis software (Minitab, JMP, etc.) used for QC release decisions

blocks.zh: 文件管理系統（DMS/EDMS）
blocks.en: Document management systems (DMS/EDMS)

blocks.zh: 驗證範圍需與軟體的使用風險成比例——影響放行決策的系統需要最嚴格的 IQ/OQ/PQ 驗證。
blocks.en: The scope of validation must be proportionate to the risk of the software's use; systems that affect release decisions require the most rigorous IQ/OQ/PQ validation.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：風險導向流程控制
blocks.en: Analogy: Risk-Based Process Control

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 要求對 QMS 流程應用「風險導向方法」。這就像航空公司的安全管理：
blocks.en: 4.1.2 requires a "risk-based approach" to be applied to QMS processes. It is like safety management at an airline:

blocks.zh: 起飛前的引擎檢查（高風險流程）需要最嚴格的確認程序；座椅靠背調整（低風險流程）則不需要同等級別的控制。
blocks.en: The pre-flight engine check (a high-risk process) requires the strictest verification procedure, while adjusting a seat back (a low-risk process) does not need the same level of control.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的 QMS 中，這意味著：無菌灌裝流程（直接影響患者安全）的流程控制遠比行政費用報銷流程嚴格，文件要求、監控頻率、人員資格要求也隨風險等級遞增。
blocks.en: In a CDMO's QMS this means: process controls for aseptic filling (which directly affects patient safety) are far stricter than those for expense reimbursement, and documentation requirements, monitoring frequency and personnel qualification requirements all increase with the risk level.

blocks.zh: Clause 4.2 — 文件要求：從手冊到記錄的完整架構
blocks.en: Clause 4.2 — Documentation Requirements: The Complete Structure from Manual to Records

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Medical Device File（4.2.3）— ISO 13485 的核心創新
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: Medical Device File (4.2.3) — The Core Innovation of ISO 13485

blocks.zh: MDF 是 ISO 13485 相對於 ISO 9001 最具特色的獨特要求。它不是一份單一文件，而是一套文件集合：
blocks.en: The MDF is the most distinctive requirement of ISO 13485 relative to ISO 9001. It is not a single document but a collection of documents:

blocks.zh: 器械描述 + 預期用途 + 標籤（含 IFU）
blocks.en: Device description + intended use + labeling (including IFU)

blocks.zh: 產品規格書（材料、尺寸、性能）
blocks.en: Product specifications (materials, dimensions, performance)

blocks.zh: 製造/包裝/儲存/配送程序
blocks.en: Procedures for manufacturing, packaging, storage and distribution

blocks.zh: 量測和監控程序
blocks.en: Measuring and monitoring procedures

blocks.zh: 安裝要求（如適用）
blocks.en: Installation requirements (if applicable)

blocks.zh: 服務程序（如適用）
blocks.en: Servicing procedures (if applicable)

blocks.zh: MDF 的概念與 FDA QSR 的 Device History Record (DHR) + Device Master Record (DMR) 體系和歐盟 MDR 的 Technical Documentation 高度對應。
blocks.en: The MDF concept corresponds closely to the FDA QSR Device History Record (DHR) + Device Master Record (DMR) system and to the Technical Documentation of the EU MDR.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的含義：CDMO 通常不擁有 MDF（客戶擁有），但需要向 MDF 貢獻製造相關文件（第 c 點），並確保自己的生產程序能對應到客戶 MDF 的要求。
blocks.en: What it means for a CDMO: a CDMO usually does not own the MDF (the customer does), but it needs to contribute manufacturing-related documents to the MDF (item c) and ensure that its own production procedures map to the requirements of the customer's MDF.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：文件管制的 8 項控制 — 稽核熱點
blocks.en: Key Point: The 8 Controls for Control of Documents — Audit Hot Spots

blocks.zh: 4.2.4 列出 8 項（a–h）文件管制要求，每一項都是稽核觀察點：
blocks.en: 4.2.4 lists 8 requirements (a–h) for control of documents, and each one is an audit observation point:

blocks.zh: a) 發行前審批：新版 SOP 未批准即使用 → Nonconformity
blocks.en: a) Approval before issue: a new SOP version used without approval → Nonconformity

blocks.zh: b) 審查與再批准：SOP 上次修訂已超過規定週期未審查 → Observation
blocks.en: b) Review and re-approval: an SOP not reviewed beyond its defined cycle since the last revision → Observation

blocks.zh: c) 識別現行版本：文件缺少版次標識或修訂履歷 → Nonconformity
blocks.en: c) Identification of the current version: a document lacking a version identifier or revision history → Nonconformity

blocks.zh: d) 使用點可得性：生產現場使用過期版本 SOP → Major NC
blocks.en: d) Availability at points of use: an obsolete SOP version used on the shop floor → Major NC

blocks.zh: e) 清晰可識別：字跡模糊的作業指導書 → Observation
blocks.en: e) Legible and readily identifiable: a work instruction with illegible writing → Observation

blocks.zh: f) 外來文件管制：客戶規格書未登錄文件清單 → Nonconformity
blocks.en: f) Control of external documents: a customer specification not entered in the document list → Nonconformity

blocks.zh: g) 防止損壞/遺失：電子文件無備份機制 → Observation
blocks.en: g) Prevention of deterioration or loss: electronic documents with no backup mechanism → Observation

blocks.zh: h) 防止誤用廢止文件：舊版 SOP 仍在現場未標記「已廢止」→ Major NC
blocks.en: h) Prevention of unintended use of obsolete documents: an old SOP still on the shop floor without an "obsolete" mark → Major NC

blocks.zh: 概念解析：記錄保存期限的計算邏輯
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The Logic for Calculating Record Retention Periods

blocks.zh: 4.2.5 的記錄保存要求是三個條件取最長：
blocks.en: The record retention requirement in 4.2.5 is the longest of three conditions:

blocks.zh: 組織定義的器械生命週期
blocks.en: The lifetime of the device as defined by the organization

blocks.zh: 最少自器械放行起 2 年
blocks.en: At least 2 years from the date of release of the device

blocks.zh: 適用法規要求的保存期限
blocks.en: The retention period required by applicable regulations

blocks.zh: 實務參考：
blocks.en: Practical references:

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR 820.180：記錄保存至少 2 年或器械預期壽命（取較長）
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR 820.180: retain records for at least 2 years or the expected life of the device, whichever is longer

blocks.zh: EU MDR：植入式器械記錄需保存至少 15 年
blocks.en: EU MDR: records for implantable devices must be kept for at least 15 years

blocks.zh: 一般消耗性器械（PFS/注射器）：通常 5–10 年
blocks.en: General disposable devices (PFS/syringes): typically 5–10 years

blocks.zh: CDMO 必須在品質協議中與客戶確認保存期限，確保各方一致。
blocks.en: The CDMO must confirm the retention period with the customer in the quality agreement so that all parties are aligned.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：文件 vs. 記錄的本質差異
blocks.en: Analogy: The Essential Difference between Documents and Records

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 明確區分「文件（document）」和「記錄（record）」：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 clearly distinguishes "documents" from "records":

blocks.zh: 文件：告訴你「應該怎麼做」的規定性文件（SOP、規格書、手冊）——可以被修訂更新。
blocks.en: Documents: prescriptive documents that tell you "how it should be done" (SOPs, specifications, manuals); they can be revised and updated.

blocks.zh: 記錄：證明你「已經做了什麼」的客觀證據（批次記錄、測試報告）——不能被修改，只能更正（需留稽核軌跡）。
blocks.en: Records: objective evidence that proves "what has been done" (batch records, test reports); they cannot be modified, only corrected (with an audit trail).

blocks.zh: 類比：食譜（文件）可以改版；你昨天實際做了什麼料理的記錄（記錄）不能回頭修改。稽核員最關注：記錄是否真實反映了實際發生的事情。
blocks.en: Analogy: a recipe (document) can be revised, but the record of what dish you actually cooked yesterday (record) cannot be changed after the fact. What auditors care about most is whether the records truthfully reflect what actually happened.

blocks.zh: 實務思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: CDMO 接受一個新客戶，客戶提供了一份詳細的器械規格書（Product Specification）和一份 MDF 摘要。根據 4.2.3 和 4.2.4，CDMO 應該如何將這些外來文件整合進自己的 QMS 文件管制系統？
blocks.en: A CDMO accepts a new customer, who provides a detailed device specification (Product Specification) and an MDF summary. According to 4.2.3 and 4.2.4, how should the CDMO integrate these external documents into its own QMS document control system?

blocks.zh: 生產現場的操作員使用了一份已廢止的灌裝參數設定 SOP（Revision A 而非最新的 Revision C）完成了一批生產。根據 4.2.4(h)，這是哪個級別的缺失（Observation / Minor NC / Major NC）？CAPA 應如何制定？
blocks.en: An operator on the shop floor completed a production batch using an obsolete filling parameter SOP (Revision A instead of the latest Revision C). Under 4.2.4(h), what grade of finding is this (Observation / Minor NC / Major NC)? How should the CAPA be formulated?

blocks.zh: 某植入式醫療器械（心臟支架）的批次記錄，器械生命週期客戶定義為 10 年，器械於 2026 年放行。考慮 EU MDR 的 15 年要求，這批記錄最少應保存到哪一年？
blocks.en: For the batch record of an implantable medical device (a cardiac stent), the customer defines the device lifetime as 10 years, and the device is released in 2026. Considering the 15-year EU MDR requirement, until which year must this batch record be retained at a minimum?

blocks.zh: 概念解析：QMS 文件層次架構
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The QMS Documentation Hierarchy

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的文件體系構成一個金字塔：
blocks.en: The ISO 13485 documentation system forms a pyramid:

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 比 ISO 9001 更嚴格的地方在於：Legal 4 適用法規文件（如 FDA 法規、CE 技術文件）也是文件體系的一部分，需納入管制。
blocks.en: Where ISO 13485 is stricter than ISO 9001: Legal 4 applicable regulatory documents (such as FDA regulations and CE technical documentation) are also part of the documentation system and must be brought under control.

blocks.zh: Clause 5.1–5.4 — 管理責任：承諾、客戶焦點、方針與規劃
blocks.en: Clause 5.1–5.4 — Management Responsibility: Commitment, Customer Focus, Policy and Planning

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Management Commitment（5.1）的「evidence」要求
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: The "Evidence" Requirement of Management Commitment (5.1)

blocks.zh: 注意 5.1 的措辭：「provide evidence of its commitment」。Top Management 的承諾不是空話，稽核員會尋找具體的客觀證據：
blocks.en: Note the wording of 5.1: "provide evidence of its commitment". Top Management's commitment is not empty talk, and auditors look for concrete objective evidence:

blocks.zh: 管理審查會議記錄（是否有 Top Management 親自參與？）
blocks.en: Management review meeting minutes (did Top Management take part in person?)

blocks.zh: 品質目標的分配（是否落實到各職能部門？）
blocks.en: Allocation of quality objectives (are they cascaded to each functional department?)

blocks.zh: 資源分配決定（預算、人員配置）
blocks.en: Resource allocation decisions (budget, staffing)

blocks.zh: 法規溝通記錄（Top Management 是否了解適用法規？）
blocks.en: Records of regulatory communication (does Top Management understand the applicable regulations?)

blocks.zh: 若稽核員發現管理審查由 QA 副理代替 CEO 主持，這可能構成 5.1 的 Observation——「Top Management 未直接提供承諾的證據」。
blocks.en: If an auditor finds that the management review was chaired by a QA deputy manager instead of the CEO, this may constitute an Observation against 5.1: "Top Management has not directly provided evidence of commitment".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：5.4.1 品質目標必須包含法規要求
blocks.en: Key Point: Quality Objectives in 5.4.1 Must Include Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 在 5.4.1 明確要求品質目標需包含「適用法規要求所需的目標」。這意味著：
blocks.en: In 5.4.1, ISO 13485 explicitly requires quality objectives to include "those needed to meet applicable regulatory requirements". This means:

blocks.zh: 若適用法規要求投訴回應時限為 30 天，品質目標可能需要設定為「100% 投訴在 30 天內初步回應」
blocks.en: If the applicable regulation sets a complaint response time of 30 days, the quality objective may need to be set as "100% of complaints receive an initial response within 30 days"

blocks.zh: 若 FDA 483 觀察事項要求改善特定流程，相關改善目標應納入品質目標
blocks.en: If an FDA 483 observation requires improvement of a specific process, the related improvement targets should be included in the quality objectives

blocks.zh: 品質目標必須「可測量（measurable）」——非「提升客戶滿意度」，而是「客戶滿意度調查分數 ≥ 4.2/5」
blocks.en: Quality objectives must be "measurable": not "improve customer satisfaction", but "customer satisfaction survey score ≥ 4.2/5"

blocks.zh: 類比說明：5.4.2 QMS 完整性在變更時的保護
blocks.en: Analogy: Protecting QMS Integrity during Changes (5.4.2)

blocks.zh: 5.4.2(b) 要求在 QMS 變更時「維護 QMS 的完整性」。這就像醫院在裝修手術室時——施工期間不能停止手術，需要有臨時措施確保無菌操作的連續性。
blocks.en: 5.4.2(b) requires that "the integrity of the QMS is maintained when changes to the QMS are planned and implemented". It is like a hospital renovating an operating room: surgeries cannot stop during construction, so interim measures are needed to ensure the continuity of aseptic operations.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的場景中：當組織遷廠、更換 ERP 系統或擴增新產品線時，需要事先規劃：哪些 QMS 流程會受影響？如何確保在過渡期間品質控制不中斷？這些規劃需要文件化。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting: when the organization relocates its site, replaces its ERP system or adds a new product line, it needs to plan in advance which QMS processes will be affected and how to ensure that quality control is not interrupted during the transition. This planning must be documented.

blocks.zh: 概念解析：5.3 品質方針 — 與 ISO 9001 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: 5.3 Quality Policy — A Key Difference from ISO 9001

blocks.zh: 這是一個微妙但重要的差異：
blocks.en: This is a subtle but important difference:

blocks.zh: 實務意義：ISO 13485 的品質方針不必承諾「持續改進」——這反映了監管邏輯：法規要的是一致性合規，而非開放式的改善承諾。但若組織的品質方針同時聲稱符合 ISO 9001，則必須加回持續改進承諾。
blocks.en: Practical significance: the quality policy in ISO 13485 need not include a commitment to "continual improvement". This reflects regulatory logic: regulations want consistent compliance, not open-ended improvement commitments. However, if the organization's quality policy also claims conformity to ISO 9001, the continual improvement commitment must be added back.

blocks.zh: Clause 5.5–5.6 — 責任與授權、內部溝通、管理審查
blocks.en: Clause 5.5–5.6 — Responsibility and Authority, Internal Communication, Management Review

blocks.zh: 概念解析：5.5.1 責任矩陣 — 「獨立性」的法規要求
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: 5.5.1 Responsibility Matrix — The Regulatory Requirement for "Independence"

blocks.zh: 5.5.1 特別要求確保影響品質人員的「獨立性和授權」。這在醫療器械行業有特定意涵：
blocks.en: 5.5.1 specifically requires "independence and authority" for personnel who affect quality. This has a specific meaning in the medical device industry:

blocks.zh: QA/QC 人員不能向生產主管直接匯報（避免商業壓力影響品質決定）
blocks.en: QA/QC personnel must not report directly to the production head (to prevent commercial pressure from influencing quality decisions)

blocks.zh: 負責最終放行決策的 QP（Qualified Person）必須有拒絕放行的獨立授權
blocks.en: The QP (Qualified Person) responsible for the final release decision must have independent authority to refuse release

blocks.zh: 稽核員（Internal Auditor）不能稽核自己負責的流程
blocks.en: Internal auditors must not audit processes for which they are themselves responsible

blocks.zh: 文件要求：需有組織架構圖（Org Chart）+ 職責說明書（Job Description）+ 職責矩陣（RACI Matrix），三者需一致。
blocks.en: Documentation requirements: an Org Chart + Job Descriptions + a Responsibility (RACI) Matrix are needed, and the three must be consistent.

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Management Representative（5.5.2）的特殊職責
blocks.en: Concept Analysis: Special Responsibilities of the Management Representative (5.5.2)

blocks.zh: 5.5.2 的 Management Representative（管理代表）在 ISO 13485 中有一個在 ISO 9001:2015 中已被取消的特定要求：這個職位必須是「management 的成員」（不能只是普通員工）。
blocks.en: The Management Representative in 5.5.2 carries a specific requirement in ISO 13485 that has been dropped in ISO 9001:2015: this position must be "a member of management" (not just an ordinary employee).

blocks.zh: 關鍵職責 c）要求管理代表確保「適用法規要求的認知在整個組織內推廣」——這意味著：
blocks.en: Key responsibility c) requires the management representative to ensure "the promotion of awareness of applicable regulatory requirements and QMS requirements throughout the organization", which means:

blocks.zh: 當 FDA 或 EU 更新法規時，管理代表有責任確保組織知曉
blocks.en: When the FDA or the EU updates its regulations, the management representative is responsible for ensuring that the organization is aware of them

blocks.zh: 法規培訓計劃應由管理代表督導
blocks.en: The regulatory training program should be overseen by the management representative

blocks.zh: 稽核員可能要求面談管理代表，確認其對適用法規的掌握程度
blocks.en: Auditors may ask to interview the management representative to confirm their grasp of the applicable regulations

blocks.zh: 重點提示：5.6.2 管理審查輸入 — 醫療器械特定項目
blocks.en: Key Point: 5.6.2 Management Review Inputs — Medical Device-Specific Items

blocks.zh: 與 ISO 9001 相比，ISO 13485 的管理審查輸入增加了醫療器械特定項目：
blocks.en: Compared with ISO 9001, ISO 13485 adds medical device-specific items to the management review inputs:

blocks.zh: b) 投訴處理：需有統計摘要，含投訴率趨勢、嚴重投訴案例分析
blocks.en: b) Complaint handling: a statistical summary is required, including complaint rate trends and analysis of serious complaint cases

blocks.zh: c) 向法規機構的通報：MDR（Medical Device Reporting）、不良事件回報的統計
blocks.en: c) Reporting to regulatory authorities: statistics on MDR (Medical Device Reporting) and adverse event reporting

blocks.zh: l) 適用的新/修訂法規要求：必須告知 Top Management 法規變化及其對 QMS 的影響
blocks.en: l) New or revised applicable regulatory requirements: Top Management must be informed of regulatory changes and their impact on the QMS

blocks.zh: 常見缺失：管理審查記錄缺乏對「投訴趨勢」和「法規更新」的討論 → Major NC in FDA/notified body audits。
blocks.en: Common failure: management review records lacking any discussion of "complaint trends" and "regulatory updates" → Major NC in FDA/notified body audits.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：5.6 管理審查的本質
blocks.en: Analogy: The Essence of Management Review (5.6)

blocks.zh: 管理審查就像企業的「年度董事會健康體檢」——不是要處理個別問題（那是 CAPA 的工作），而是從系統層面評估整個 QMS 是否仍然適合、充分、有效。
blocks.en: Management review is like a company's "annual board-level health check". It is not meant to deal with individual problems (that is the job of CAPA), but to assess at the system level whether the whole QMS is still suitable, adequate and effective.

blocks.zh: 5.6.3 的輸出要求有四類決定：QMS 改善、產品改善、法規變更回應、資源需求。注意：沒有「持續改進」這個措辭——只有「維持適合性、充分性和有效性所需的改善」，這與 ISO 9001 的語言有細微但重要的差別。
blocks.en: The output requirements of 5.6.3 cover four types of decision: QMS improvement, product improvement, response to regulatory changes, and resource needs. Note: the wording "continual improvement" does not appear; there is only "improvement needed to maintain the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness", a subtle but important difference from the language of ISO 9001.

blocks.zh: 若管理審查的結論每年都是「一切良好，無需改變」，稽核員會質疑：這個審查是否真的被認真執行了？
blocks.en: If the conclusion of the management review is "everything is fine, no changes needed" every year, auditors will question whether the review is really being carried out seriously.

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 的管理審查每年由品保主任（QA Manager，非 Top Management）主持，記錄顯示從未有 CEO 或 COO 出席。根據 5.1 和 5.6 的要求，這種做法是否符合 ISO 13485？稽核員可能提出什麼觀察？
blocks.en: At a CDMO, the management review is chaired every year by the QA Manager (not Top Management), and the records show that neither the CEO nor the COO has ever attended. Under the requirements of 5.1 and 5.6, does this practice conform to ISO 13485? What observations might the auditor raise?

blocks.zh: EU MDR（EU 2017/745）於 2024 年更新了若干技術文件要求。根據 5.6.2(l) 和 5.6.3(c)，CDMO 的管理審查應如何回應這個法規變化？需要產生什麼類型的 output？
blocks.en: The EU MDR (EU 2017/745) updated several technical documentation requirements in 2024. Under 5.6.2(l) and 5.6.3(c), how should the CDMO's management review respond to this regulatory change? What type of output needs to be generated?

blocks.zh: 5.5.2 要求 Management Representative 促進全組織對法規要求的認知。設計一個簡單的機制，確保生產操作員（不直接閱讀法規原文的人）也能了解與其工作相關的法規要求更新。
blocks.en: 5.5.2 requires the Management Representative to promote awareness of regulatory requirements throughout the organization. Design a simple mechanism to ensure that production operators (who do not read the original regulatory text directly) also learn of updates to the regulatory requirements relevant to their work.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 4.1 外包不外包責任：CDMO 外包任何影響產品符合性的流程（如滅菌、分析測試）時，必須有書面品質協議，控制程度與風險成比例；QMS 軟體（ERP、LIMS、eBMR）需驗證。
blocks.en: 4.1 Outsourcing does not outsource responsibility: when a CDMO outsources any process that affects product conformity (such as sterilization or analytical testing), it must have a written quality agreement with controls proportionate to the risk; QMS software (ERP, LIMS, eBMR) must be validated.

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 Medical Device File 是 ISO 13485 的核心創新：每個器械型號/系列需有獨立的文件集，包含從描述到製造到監控的完整技術文件；CDMO 需向客戶的 MDF 貢獻製造程序文件。
blocks.en: The 4.2.3 Medical Device File is the core innovation of ISO 13485: each device type/family needs its own set of documents, including complete technical documentation from description through manufacturing to monitoring; the CDMO needs to contribute manufacturing procedure documents to the customer's MDF.

blocks.zh: 4.2.4 文件管制 8 項控制：發行前審批、審查再批准、版次識別、使用點可得性、清晰識別、外來文件管制、防損/遺失、防廢止文件誤用——每一項都是稽核熱點。
blocks.en: The 8 controls of 4.2.4 control of documents: approval before issue, review and re-approval, version identification, availability at points of use, legibility and identification, control of external documents, prevention of deterioration/loss, and prevention of unintended use of obsolete documents; each one is an audit hot spot.

blocks.zh: 5.3 品質方針無需承諾「持續改進」：ISO 13485 只要求「維護 QMS 有效性」和「遵從要求」，這是與 ISO 9001 的重要差異，體現了監管邏輯對一致性合規的優先。
blocks.en: The 5.3 quality policy need not commit to "continual improvement": ISO 13485 only requires a commitment to "maintain the effectiveness of the QMS" and to "comply with requirements"; this is an important difference from ISO 9001 and reflects the regulatory priority on consistent compliance.

blocks.zh: 5.6 管理審查有醫療器械特定輸入：投訴處理狀況、法規機構通報記錄、適用新/修訂法規要求——這三項輸入是 ISO 9001 沒有的，確保 Top Management 持續了解法規動態並作出決策。
blocks.en: 5.6 management review has medical device-specific inputs: complaint handling status, records of reporting to regulatory authorities, and new or revised applicable regulatory requirements; these three inputs do not exist in ISO 9001 and ensure that Top Management stays informed of regulatory developments and makes decisions accordingly.
